description: This file serves as a base class for context-sensitive tests within the OpenMRS project, specifically tailored for JUnit 5 and Spring. It provides setup and teardown methods for initializing an in-memory or external database, managing user authentication, loading datasets via DBUnit, configuring Hibernate sessions, and facilitating test-specific configurations. The class is used to support comprehensive integration testing involving the OpenMRS context, database, and services, with several utilities for dataset management and environment assumptions.

classes.name: BaseContextSensitiveTest
classes.description: Abstract base class for OpenMRS JUnit 5 tests requiring context, database setup, and dataset management.

methods.name: initializeInMemoryDatabase
methods.description: Sets up and populates an in-memory H2 database with initial test data.

methods.name: executeDataSet
methods.description: Loads predefined datasets into the database to prepare for tests.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication, prompting for credentials if needed.
